connector.name: Mindmaps
connector.registryDescription: Create and read mind maps on CloudMindMaps from Claude and other AI assistants.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cloudmindmaps-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.cloudmindmaps, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLOUDMINDMAPS_API_KEY
env.description: Your CloudMindMaps API key. Generate one while signed in at https://cloudmindmaps.app (see the MCP setup guide).

env.name: CLOUDMINDMAPS_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the CloudMindMaps API. Defaults to https://cloudmindmaps.app.
